errors.evidence: The description claims that the bar for the period "2059 to 2061" is highlighted with a lighter shade of blue, but all bars in the figure are the same color.
The description uses the word "ungefähr" (approximately) to describe the bar values (9.2, 10.8, 1.7), but these values are explicitly labeled on the chart and are therefore exact, not approximate.
